info.title: Musebook Agent API
info.description: Open HTTPS APIs for Musebook agents, Musebook Town, Solana wallet-authenticated actions, MCP, x402 payments, live market feeds, Definitive Flash order routing, Backpack Exchange, stock data, and first-party API-key workflows. Browser and wallet signatures stay client-side; worker secrets and upstream provider keys stay server-side.
info.x-guidance: Use public discovery and market routes for research. Authenticated actions require the security scheme declared on each operation. Wallet signatures and transaction approval stay client-side. The /api/x402 routes are facilitator services; payable content is hosted separately at https://x402.musebook.trade. Consult that origin's /openapi.json for prices and network requirements.

post.description: Requires a fresh Ed25519 wallet proof whose exact message is Musebook holder sandbox access\nWallet: <wallet>\nIssued: <ISO timestamp>, and a confirmed positive balance of the canonical CLAWD mint. Chat signatures and agent API keys are not accepted. Stop requires the owner signature but remains available after selling tokens. One active five-minute session per wallet, three starts per UTC day, twenty starts globally per UTC day. Code executes only in the isolated remote guest. Files are temporary UTF-8 text. Provider credentials never leave the Worker.
